lessons.title: Week 91 Part 1: Understanding the Child's Experience of Care & Contact
lessons.content: In Week 91 of Reunification Readiness & Sustained Safe Care, this lesson focuses on understanding the child's experience of care & contact. Parents and carers practise pausing to notice stress cues, responding with calm and predictable language, maintaining child-safe boundaries, and recording one observable example of how this skill supported their child's safety and emotional wellbeing this week.
